narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On February 13, 2024, at approximately 0745 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a bus stop in Ypsilanti, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Guatemala and showed a Guatemalan passport. He has no permission to be in the United States.
TRAVEL AND ENTRY:
The subject stated that he left Huehuetenango in early January 2019 and entered Mexico without documents at Ciudad Hidalgo, Chiapas, on 01/10/2019. He worked in Monterrey for several months to pay for the rest of the trip.
He crossed the Rio Grande into the United States on foot near Hidalgo, Texas, on 06/02/2019 without being inspected, and travelled to Michigan by bus a year later.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
